criteria.statement: [AC-001] R064 요청·교정 관측·memory와 현재 source를 hash로 고정하고 context/epoch/edge/provenance 사실 계약, 비교군·조건·예측을 실행 전에 동결한다.
criteria.observedResult: Source, parent hashes, matrix, scope, predictions and units frozen before native evaluation.; Five exact pinned requested-measurement and native-memory input files verified.
criteria.rationale: Verified evidence for the current target supports this criterion.

criteria.statement: [AC-002] binary/edge 정보 경로별 current/record_only/lookup 및 회로 ON/OFF를 동일 조건에서 비교하고 같은 상황·다른 context·새 epoch·미통지 변화·정확 관측의 원입력/조회/실입력/판단/proof/readout/비용을 보존한다.
criteria.observedResult: 60 raw evaluations with matched within-channel memory, original/actual input, facts and native measurements; recording-only same in 20 comparisons.; 60 independent native formula replays, separate keyed fact join and 13 rejected mutations; no absent candidate.
criteria.rationale: Verified evidence for the current target supports this criterion.

criteria.statement: [AC-003] 별도 로직·프로세스의 사실 조회 재계산과 native 수식 replay, unknown/conflict/변조 self-test, 원클릭 source/input/bundle/ZIP 무결성, 최종 core 회귀 1회와 색인·기존 파일 보존을 확인한다.
criteria.observedResult: 60 independent native formula replays, separate keyed fact join and 13 rejected mutations; no absent candidate.; 10 synthetic boundary checks including unknown, conflict, rebinding, invalid value types and binary no-inference.; 602 tests, 599 pass, original three environment skips, no new errors or skips.; 800 research files, 380 frozen source files, recovery and ZIP verified; 26456 prior out-of-scope files preserved; index valid.; Scope PASS: no excluded/unplanned/preexisting-overlap changes.
criteria.rationale: Verified evidence for the current target supports this criterion.

criteria.statement: [AC-004] 정보 접근의 효과와 구조 재사용 비용을 분리해 결과와 주장 한계·다음 판별 실험을 기록하고 커밋·main 병합·작업 브랜치 정리·origin/main 반영을 확인한다.
criteria.observedResult: Results separate input intervention, record-only behavior, stale fact failure and native structural reuse costs.; Next discriminator holds e0 and additional observation budget fixed across unchanged and changed worlds.; Research commit merged to local main, branch deleted and exact origin/main verified.
criteria.rationale: Verified evidence for the current target supports this criterion.
